games.name: MPS Futsal
games.desc:
MPS Futsal is an exciting, fast-paced football game!
In MPS Futsal, you play in a small arena with opposition and teammates, like in soccer/football, using a few tools to interact with the ball.

MPS Futsal is based on as its name implies, Futsal and soccer.
Futsal is a faster-paced version of soccer/football, typically played on a smaller field with fewer players than regular soccer/football.
This results in a faster-paced game, more exciting, and more goal-scoring opportunities than regular soccer/football.

Please consider liking and favoriting MPS Futsal, as it helps us out immensely as a small game.

games.name: Idle Potato Game
games.desc:
A 2D incremental idle/clicker game about potato farming. Start with nothing but a single potato plant and grow your tiny potato farm into an automated potato empire. It starts off simple but you unlock more layers and mechanics as you progress. Climb the leaderboards through strategic upgrades, automated generators, and our unique rebirth system.

Features:
Auto-clicker is free for everyone
Global and Server-wide leaderboards to compare your stats
Endless content and constant content updates
200+ upgrades and perks to purchase
Prestige/Rebirth system to get permanent multipliers - Multi-layered!
300+ achievements to unlock
Tons of collectable potatoes that give stacking buffs and have unique animations. The more you collect, the more buffs you get!
Find ultra rare potatoes just from playing!
Trading system - Almost everything is tradable! Trade rare, epic, legendary, and mythic potatoes with other players!
Rotating global shop system
Offline progress, your generators never sleep!
